_comment: ATIVE Casino Bot - Pterodactyl Egg Configuration
name: ATIVE Casino Bot
author: ative@casino.bot
description: A professional Discord casino bot built with JavaScript, featuring multi-database support (MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Firebase), automated backups, health monitoring, and comprehensive game systems.
startup: if [[ -f startup.sh ]]; then bash startup.sh; else node index.js; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

## File: ATIVE Casino Bot Installation Script
## Author: ATIVE Casino Bot Team

apt update
apt install -y git curl wget tar gzip unzip

cd /mnt/server

echo "🎰 Installing ATIVE Casino Bot..."

## Download or clone bot files
if [ -n "${GIT_REPOSITORY}" ]; then
    echo "📥 Cloning from repository: ${GIT_REPOSITORY}"
    
    if [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${GIT_BRANCH} ${GIT_REPOSITORY} .
    else
        git clone ${GIT_REPOSITORY} .
    fi
    
    echo "✅ Repository cloned successfully"
else
    echo "⚠️  No GIT_REPOSITORY provided, assuming files are already uploaded"
fi

## Install Node.js dependencies
echo "📦 Installing Node.js dependencies..."
npm install --production

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "✅ Dependencies installed successfully"
else
    echo "❌ Failed to install dependencies"
    exit 1
fi

## Create necessary directories
echo "📁 Creating directories..."
mkdir -p logs backups temp

## Set permissions
echo "🔧 Setting permissions..."
chmod +x startup.sh 2>/dev/null || echo "startup.sh not found, will use default startup"
chmod +x scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null || echo "No script files found"

## Create .env from template if it doesn't exist
if [ -f ".env.pterodactyl" ] && [ ! -f ".env" ]; then
    echo "⚙️  Creating .env from template..."
    cp .env.pterodactyl .env
fi

echo "🎉 ATIVE Casino Bot installation completed!"
echo "📋 Next steps:"
echo "   1. Configure your .env file with Discord token and database credentials"
echo "   2. Start the server"
echo "   3. The bot will automatically set up database schema on first run"

exit 0

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: The Discord bot token from Discord Developer Portal. Required for bot authentication.

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: The Discord application client ID from Discord Developer Portal. Required for slash commands.

variables.name: Environment
variables.description: Runtime environment for the bot. Use 'production' for live deployment.

variables.name: MariaDB Host
variables.description: MariaDB database host address. Use the database host from your Pterodactyl panel.

variables.name: MariaDB Port
variables.description: MariaDB database port number. Default is 3306.

variables.name: MariaDB Username
variables.description: MariaDB database username. Get this from your Pterodactyl database settings.

variables.name: MariaDB Password
variables.description: MariaDB database password. Keep this secure and get it from your database settings.

variables.name: MariaDB Database Name
variables.description: MariaDB database name. Create a database named 'ative_casino' or customize here.

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Port for health checks and monitoring endpoints. Default is 3000.

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Git repository URL to clone the bot files from (optional, if not uploading manually).

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Git branch to clone (optional, defaults to main/master).

variables.name: Developer ID
variables.description: Discord user ID for developer access. Default is the original developer ID.

variables.name: Log Channel ID
variables.description: Discord channel ID for error logging and admin notifications.

variables.name: Enable Health Checks
variables.description: Enable automated health monitoring and checks.
